Incoterms 2020

Verifica del peso

The certified process of confirming and documenting the gross weight of a packed container, as required by SOLAS and port authorities.

Questions and answers

What is Verifica del peso?

In this glossary, Verifica del peso refers to: The certified process of confirming and documenting the gross weight of a packed container, as required by SOLAS and port authorities.

How is Verifica del peso used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La verifica del peso è obbligatoria prima del carico secondo SOLAS, con richiesta del certificato VGM."

Why does Verifica del peso matter in logistics?

Verifica del peso matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Verifica del peso?

Verifica del peso is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Verifica del peso belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The certified process of confirming and documenting the gross weight of a packed container, as required by SOLAS and port authorities.

Operational example

Weight verification is mandatory before vessel loading under SOLAS, requiring shippers to submit a verified gross mass (VGM) certificate.

Localized term

Verifica del peso

Localized example

La verifica del peso è obbligatoria prima del carico secondo SOLAS, con richiesta del certificato VGM.
